\caption{\bt{Accuracy of the user agent by data change, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Each small dot is one of three independent runs per method and the large marker the accuracy over their tasks; a hollow marker means that at least 25\% of the tasks used a stale definition, i.e., one whose canonical SQL answers that setting's questions incorrectly. Bands group the changes by the condition they target. Right: invalidations and published repairs per run for the methods that maintain definitions, dots for the individual runs. In all, \ScenCells\ runs, \ScenValidTasks\ scored tasks, and \ScenAgentHours\ agent-hours.}{按数据变化划分的用户端智能体正确率，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。每个小点是该方法 3 次独立运行中的一次，大点是这些运行全部题目上的正确率；空心表示该情形下至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其规范 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。底色按变化针对的条件分组。右：维护定义的方法每次运行的失效数与发布的修复数，小点为各次运行。共 \ScenCells\ 次运行、\ScenValidTasks\ 道计分题、\ScenAgentHours\ 智能体小时。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{Left: a dot plot with the twelve settings on the horizontal axis, grouped into none, benign, grain, join fan-out, completeness, not covered, and ambiguous fix, and accuracy from 0 to 100 percent on the vertical axis; six methods per setting, each with three small per-run dots and one large mean marker. All sharing methods sit at 100 percent on the held-out and benign settings while no sharing lies between 30 and 67 percent. Under status-change rows MAVRA and definition-level are at 100 percent, trajectory retrieval and no validation at 50 with hollow markers, self-check at 61. Under restatements MAVRA is at 93 and definition-level at 100, trajectory retrieval at 78; under duplicate loads MAVRA and definition-level at 59, trajectory retrieval at 37. Under SCD Type 2 every sharing method is at 100. Under the date-key format change all methods lie between 11 and 22 percent, under the unit change between 44 and 52, and under the backup copy trajectory retrieval is highest at 72 with MAVRA at 56. Right: horizontal bars of invalidations and repairs per run: invalidate-on-write 40 and 0, definition-level 21.3 and 8.7, MAVRA with G8 on current data 21.0 and 4.7, MAVRA 25.7 and 10.3.}
